==Biography==
Shunsuke "'''Evi'''" Murase started League of Legends in May, 2013 and quickly climbed the ladder to Diamond I in in December, 2013.

== Trivia ==
* Interested in cooking - his specialty is fried eggs.
* Gives the camera a thumbs-up whenever he notices it pointed at him during a game.
